In Memoriam

Researchers in this directory who are no longer with us

The Top 100 and the regional pages list living researchers only, so the directory stays accurate for anyone using it to make contact. This page remembers the 11 researchers in the ranked pool who have passed away. Several of them, including G. H. Hardy and J. E. Littlewood, are foundational figures whose methods modern Goldbach research still builds on.
